classification.summary: Aave-fork empty-market donation inflated index plus rounding error to over-withdraw

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/mahalend.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.

sources.note: onchain review: the victim's executing code is immutable - zero DELEGATECALL opcodes in the deployed runtime and an identical codehash at the creation block and the incident block - so the deployment basis is an exact measurement, not an upper bound; nonStandardUpgradeArchitecture removed accordingly

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis (correcting one detail of the earlier note: the runtime does contain 14 DELEGATECALL opcodes, but they are solc external-library calls to seven link-time-hardcoded addresses, not an upgrade hook). The recorded victim is the Aave-v3 `Pool` implementation, not the live pool - every storage slot 0..59 reads zero at both the creation and incident blocks. The live pool proxy is 0x76f0c94ced5b48020bf0d7f3d0ceabc877744cb5, created 13 blocks (168 s) after the implementation, and its EIP-1967 slot has held 0xfd11aba7... from its creation block 16167084 to the incident (25-point probe, single 0x0 -> impl transition). So the executing code is unchanged from the implementation's deployment either way.

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0xfd11aba71c06061f446ade4eec057179f19c23c4 to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x76f0c94ced5b48020bf0d7f3d0ceabc877744cb5, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (28826964s -> 28826796s)

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/mahalend.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
The legacy USD loss lacks uniformly structured valuation provenance.
